claims.text: The two selected native generate shards retain sealed cells and pass independent dataset verify on the same untwisted and twisted prime n23 m2 BSGS configurations.

decision_rule.text: Retain every success, failure or timeout. Promote only cells whose sealed manifests independently verify; direct-worker durations inform planning only.

inadmissible: selecting a replacement seed after a failure
discarding a failed or timed-out attempt
using direct-worker time as measured full-generate time

promoting an unsealed or unverified cell
